integrity: Previously known maximum cardinality and Fano construction are explicitly credited. The new contribution is the necessary equality-case classification and count of every optimal labeled code. Computational checks are finite and do not replace the symbolic universal proof.
limitations: Only length-four multiset codes over a seven-symbol labeled alphabet with one deletion; not ordered strings or other blocklengths. Earlier unindexed extremizer classifications remain a possible originality risk.
title: Fano-plane rigidity of optimal seven-symbol four-multiset deletion codes
